slides.headline: A couple gave their US university $20 million. It became a college named for them - built entirely around AI.
Vikas and Anuradha Sinha gave the University of North Texas $20 million to launch an AI college
slides.body: The gift, announced September 9, 2026, established the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics - funding six permanent endowments spanning leadership, scholarships, endowed professorships, entrepreneurship incubation and research.

slides.headline: This was their third gift to the same university in two years.
slides.body: Vikas Sinha came to the US from India to study civil engineering, later earning a PhD in data science from UNT in 2023. Earlier gifts had already created the university's Department of Data Science and its Sinha Innovation Lab - this one turned a department into an entire college.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when its diaspora builds AI capacity abroad, not just at home.
slides.body: The Sinhas didn't just donate money once - they kept building on the same institution, turning a single gift into a growing academic hub for the field India's own workforce will need most.
